description: This file defines an abstract class for building answers to live commands in a query context, including response handling and command response creation.

classes.name: AbstractLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base implementation for building answer objects for live query commands, handling response creation and configuration.

methods.name: AbstractLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the builder with a specific command, checking for null.

methods.name: withResponse
methods.description: Sets a custom response creation function to be used when building the command answer.

methods.name: withoutResponse
methods.description: Resets or skips response creation, returning the builder for chaining.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns a LiveCommandAnswer object, utilizing the configured response creation logic.

methods.name: doCreateResponse
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses for creating a CommandResponse based on a provided function.
